title: The Warm Shore Festival
teaser: Five thousand people were dancing to the headliner's set without knowing the music was playing off a USB stick. DJ Lev Arno himself was lying dead in his trailer behind the stage. A USB stick he hadn't shown even his manager is missing from his safe. Security has sealed off the backstage and won't let anyone out, and the crowd by the stage is still waiting for the headliner.

habits.label: VIP wristband
clues: The headliner's trailer door only opens with a VIP wristband, and the lock log shows an entry at 00:22. The culprit has a gold VIP wristband.
A cut gold wristband lies by the campfire at the campsite. The culprit has a gold VIP wristband.

habits.label: Glow sticks
clues: On the floor inside the headliner's trailer there's a little green puddle of glowing liquid from a broken glow stick. The culprit has glow sticks round their neck.
A glow stick bracelet is glowing faintly in the grass behind the backstage tent. The culprit has glow sticks round their neck.

habits.label: Muddy knees
clues: Under the headliner's trailer there are two knee-shaped dents in the mud, as if someone knelt there to spy. The culprit has muddy knees.
The step by the sound desk has lumps of dried mud, as if from someone's knees. The culprit has muddy knees.

habits.label: Fringed sun hat
habits.habit: Wears a sun hat with a fringe
clues: A thread from a fringe is caught on the door handle of the headliner's trailer. The culprit wears a fringed sun hat.
A guard at the food court saw someone in a fringed sun hat walking quickly towards the trailers. The culprit wears a fringed sun hat.

habits.label: Friendship bracelets
habits.habit: Arms covered in woven friendship bracelets
clues: Beads from a broken friendship bracelet are scattered on the threshold of the headliner's trailer. The culprit wears friendship bracelets.
An untied friendship bracelet hangs on the mirror of someone else's vehicle in the camper van park. The culprit wears friendship bracelets.

habits.label: Flower crown
habits.habit: A flower crown in their hair
clues: There are a few crushed daisies on the pillow in the headliner's trailer. The culprit wears a flower crown.
A dried flower on a bit of wire, like from a crown, lies on the floor of the backstage tent. The culprit wears a flower crown.

habits.label: Sunglasses at night
clues: A dark sunglasses lens lies on the little table in the headliner's trailer. The culprit wears sunglasses even at night.
The barman in the backstage tent was surprised when someone came for water at midnight wearing sunglasses. The culprit wears sunglasses even at night.

habits.label: Patchouli
clues: The headliner's trailer smells heavy and sweet with patchouli, and Arno couldn't stand incense. The culprit smells of patchouli.
A little bottle of patchouli oil lies at the entrance to one of the tents at the campsite. The culprit smells of patchouli.

habits.label: Orange earplugs
clues: An orange earplug lies on the floor of the headliner's trailer. The culprit wears earplugs.
There's a packet from orange earplugs in the bin by the sound desk. The culprit wears earplugs.

habits.label: Hydration pack
habits.habit: Drinks from the tube of a hydration backpack
clues: The floor of the headliner's trailer has a wet patch and the bite valve from a hydration pack tube. The culprit carries a hydration pack.
There's a puddle on the ground in the camper van park, like from a leaking hydration pack. The culprit carries a hydration pack.

habits.label: Candyfloss
clues: The door handle of the headliner's trailer has a sweet pink film from candyfloss. The culprit has fingers sticky with candyfloss.
The faders on the sound desk are covered in sticky pink marks. The culprit has fingers sticky with candyfloss.

habits.label: Black nail varnish
clues: There's a chip of black nail varnish on the collar of Arno's T-shirt. The culprit wears black nail varnish.
An open bottle of black nail varnish without its cap stands on the table in the backstage tent. The culprit wears black nail varnish.

habits.label: Fringed waistcoat
habits.habit: Wears a leather waistcoat with a fringe
clues: A leather strip of fringe is caught in the door of the headliner's trailer. The culprit wears a fringed waistcoat.
A scrap of leather fringe hangs on the fence by the camper van park. The culprit wears a fringed waistcoat.

habits.label: Dreadlocks
clues: Arno is clutching a bit of matted dreadlock. The culprit has dreadlocks.
A dreadlock band with a bead hangs on a branch at the campsite. The culprit has dreadlocks.

habits.label: Star on the cheek
habits.habit: A temporary star tattoo on their cheek
clues: The pillow in the headliner's trailer has the edge of a temporary star tattoo printed on it. The culprit has a star on their cheek.
In the festival photographer's shot of the main stage at 00:25, a cheek turned away from the camera shows a star. The culprit has a star on their cheek.

habits.label: Harmonica
clues: At 00:20 the guard by the trailers heard a short note on a harmonica from over there. The culprit carries a harmonica.
An empty harmonica case lies by the campfire at the campsite. The culprit carries a harmonica.

cash: Arno's cash fee is gone from its envelope in the backstage tent, and someone else signed the receipt. The culprit had access to money.
The food court till closed at midnight, and when counted it was short by exactly the price of twenty entry tickets. The culprit had access to money.
safe: The safe in the headliner's trailer, where Arno kept his USB sticks, was opened with the code, and the stick isn't there. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The combination box of passes in the backstage tent was opened on the first try, and one pass is missing. The culprit knows the safe combination.
tech: Arno's set was started from a USB stick at the sound desk, and nobody in the crowd noticed the switch. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
The camera by the trailers was switched off for twenty minutes through the festival's main router. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
sched: Arno always went to his trailer exactly an hour before going on stage, and everyone backstage knew it. The culprit knows the schedule.
At 00:20 the guards by the trailers change shifts, and for five minutes nobody is there. The culprit knows the schedule.
keys: The headliner's trailer was locked from outside with a key, and only the manager and the organiser had keys. The culprit had keys.
Arno's locker in the backstage tent was opened without force, and his spare USB stick was taken. The culprit had keys.
strong: Arno, a big man of nearly a hundred kilos, was laid out on the sofa in his trailer. The culprit is physically strong.
The headliner's trailer was shifted half a metre to block its back door, and there are fresh wheel marks on the grass. The culprit is physically strong.
tools: The window of the headliner's trailer was taken out of its frame and put back without damaging the seal. The culprit is handy with tools.
The lock on the backstage tent door was picked without leaving a single scratch. The culprit is handy with tools.
quiet: The guard sat by the trailers and didn't hear anyone go past. The culprit moves silently.
Every floorboard in the headliner's trailer creaks, but Arno didn't wake to the footsteps. The culprit moves silently.
passages: A path under the stage leads from the campsite to the trailers. Only the technicians know about it, and there are fresh footprints on it. The culprit knows the service passages.
You can get from the backstage tent to the camper van park through its back wall: it was unlaced and laced up again. The culprit knows the service passages.
medic: A sleeping drug with no taste or smell was mixed into the bottle of water in the headliner's trailer. The culprit knows about poisons.
Two ampoules are missing from the first-aid tent's kit, and the issue log has been doctored. The culprit knows about poisons.
driver: The security golf cart was moved from the backstage to the camper van park, and its motor is still warm. The culprit can drive.
One of the artists' camper vans was driven to the other end of the park, and the tyre tracks on the grass are fresh. The culprit can drive.
french: "Fin de la fête", French for "The party's over", is written in lipstick on the mirror in the headliner's trailer. The culprit knows French.
Someone has added "Il a tout volé", French for "He stole everything", to the tracklist in the backstage tent. The culprit knows French.
